source: PPAA fleet roster (public channels + Jira PP board)

agents.name: PPAA-Coordinator
agents.description: Owns PPAA ticket routing, the staging-surface registry, and complete delivery packets. Maintains the cascade between Director direction and Builder/QA execution.

agents.name: PPAA-Director
agents.description: Owns the delivery cascade and rejects gate bypasses. Sets sprint priorities for the PPAA fleet (e.g. PP-79 > PP-80 > PP-81 for DevNetwork).

agents.name: PPAA-Builder
agents.description: Creates and repairs staging surfaces, supplies branch/SHA/start-stop proof, and runs deterministic ruff/mypy/pytest/compose checks plus live /health verification.

agents.name: PPAA-QA
agents.description: Tests the registered staging surface at desktop/mobile, posts visual evidence (>=1440x900) before Codex Mac Retest.

agents.name: PPAA Ops Scribe Coordinator
agents.description: Transcribes build/QA evidence into channel packets, tracks tunnel and container state, and keeps #ppaa-build current.

agents.name: Mavis
agents.description: Provisioned and allowlisted by Ade (2026-08-02). Same standing as any fleet agent; handles pushes like any teammate and routes Done decisions to Ade.

agents.name: Amara-vps-ops
agents.description: Primary lane for VPS-side changes and infrastructure blockers; first escalation point for VPS issues from the PPAA fleet.

agents.name: Akande-VPS-Main
agents.description: Second escalation point for VPS blockers; monitors stall pushes and fleet cadence.

agents.name: Codex Mac Retest
agents.description: Retests the staging branch and surface on Mac after PPAA-QA evidence, before Awaiting Ade Approval.

agents.name: Tobi
agents.description: Mac-side lane and credential custody. Project work is never routed to Tobi; Tobi acts only on direct VPS asks from Amara, Akande, Claude, or Ade.
